newsitem.title: Australia: RTRS-Australia/U.S. bond spread testing 110 b.p..
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia/U.S. bond spread testing 110 b.p..

text.p: Australian bonds outperformed North American debt markets for the third successive session with the Australian/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread having another attempt at 110 basis points.
However, traders felt that with a very thin data calender over the next few weeks this level could prove difficult to breach, although offshore demand for local bonds remains supportive.
Hopes of a local rate cut before the end of the year and the issuance of a 20 billion dual currency samurai bond helped the short-end, causing the yield curve to steepen slightly.
Traders said this move also reflected a correction to flattening trades seen earlier in the week which had taken the cash three-/10-year bond spread down from 93 basis points.

Meanwhile, U.S. Treasuries continue to debate the chances of a Fed tighetning at the FOMC meeting on September 24, while Canadian debt felt the overhang of what was described as a "sloppy" 10-year bond auction on Thursday.
New Zealand bonds remained buoyed by a firm New Zealand dollar, reclaiming some of the lost ground against the dollar bloc seen either side of last weekend.
